answer_1.quote: The system, referred to as DNCASR, jointly trains a neural clustering module for generating speaker indices, and an ASR module for transcribing the spoken words.
answer_1.outputs: words with speaker indices for the entire meeting

answer_2.quote: Three metrics are used for evaluation: diarisation error rate (DER), word error rate (WER), and concatenated minimum-permutation word error rate (cpWER).
